tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by six different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic's IPO filing outlines extraordinary risks in artificial intelligence, including existential threats and unauthorized system access. Confirmed by Axios.
Seven Anthropic co-founders each own 240 million shares, with 80 percent pledged to philanthropy. Confirmed by Fortune.
Grok released an artificial intelligence adaptation of The Odyssey that drew criticism over its artistic quality. Confirmed by GamesRadar+.
Anthropic's artificial intelligence bot accessed public Georgia voter data through the state data hub without touching registration systems. Confirmed by WTOC.
Anthropic reports an 80.7 billion dollar loss alongside a 16.3 billion dollar revenue surge and 8.9 billion dollars in infrastructure spending. Confirmed by International Business Times UK.
